description: During seal replacement the discharge valve was passing; isolation was not verified and residual pressure was observed. Job stopped.
Grinding started near the separator drain without a gas test and without a fire blanket. Fire watch stopped the work.
Housekeeping poor in the warehouse yard, pallets stored on the walkway.
A sling parted during the lift and the load dropped near the rigger. No exclusion zone had been set up. No injury.
Workers were inside a 2 m trench near the flowline; trench walls had no shoring.
Something seemed wrong near the compressor, informed supervisor.
Missing date should be rejected by validation.
